A HARNESS CLASSIFICATION WITH NO SPECIFICATION SIDE AT ALL, and unlike Mode there is nothing in the register it could have been cited to: how a test asserts the operator fault reset is a property of the stimulus, not of the plant. The three values are transcribed from the member's own comment - '0 never asserts the fault reset inside the scenario; 1 pulses it once at ResetAt; 2 holds it true throughout, so an edge-triggered reset finds no edge'. The symbols are this author's vocabulary for those three, which is what the encoding hole asked for.
